'''Beru Slee''' was a skilled individual in the art of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]]. Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this athlete participated in a Teräs Käsi competition in [[Äslajä]] and was defeated either by [[Phow Ji]] or [[Joclad Danva/Legends|Joclad Danva]] by 76-5.
